COURSE TITLE   COMMUNICATION SKILLS I
COURSE CODE     10BH1104
COURSE CREDITS  2

Objective:
 1  This course is an introduction to speech communication which emphasizes the practical
      skill of public speaking, including techniques to lessen speaker anxiety, and the use of
     visual aids to enhance speaker presentations. The purpose is to prepare students for success
     in typical public speaking situations and to provide them with the basic principles of
     organization and research needed for effective public speaking.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Understand and explain the communication process. Use presentation aids to enhance
     speeches
 2  Outline speeches, presentations in a logical and thorough fashion
 3  Plan and prepare speeches that inform, persuade, or fulfill the needs of a special occasion;
 4  Apply Listen skill and understand importance of listening in communication


Pre-requisite of course:N/A

COURSE TITLE   PSYCHOLOGY I : INTRODUCTION TO PSYCHOLOGY
COURSE CODE     10BH1101
COURSE CREDITS  3

Objective:
 1  To identify theoretical underpinnings of the major areas of psychology
 2  To introduce students to the basic concepts of the field of psychology with an emphasis on
     applications of psychology in everyday life
 3  To understand and apply basic research methods in psychology
 4  To explain different models of human behavior


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  To demonstrate understanding of the major concepts and core areas of psychology
 2  To enhance knowledge in psychology and use information in ethical manner
 3  To Respect and use critical and creative thinking and exhibit self-regulation
 4  To apply psychological skills to professional work


Pre-requisite of course:N/A

COURSE TITLE    SOCIOLOGY I: AN INTRODUCTION
COURSE CODE     10BH1103
COURSE CREDITS  3

Objective:
 1  Students will learn about the origins of sociology as a discipline
 2  Students will acquaint sociology as a social science and the distinctiveness of its
    approaches among the social sciences
 3  Students will familiarize with the basic concepts of Sociology.
 4  Students will apprise with the social processes and social institutions
 5  Students will be able to develop their sociological imagination by relating individual with
     society


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Define the evolution of sociology as a discipline
 2  Describe the various basic concepts of sociology
 3  Demonstrate the social processes underpinning the social relationships in the society
 4  Theorise the social institutions
 5  Formulate and establish the relationships between individual and society
